Belagavi-based artist Mahesh Honule (right) showcasing tourist places during a solo exhibition in Mumbai. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
Mahesh Honule, a Belagavi-based artist, is showcasing the tourist places of Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Goa in his solo exhibition in Mumbai.
The exhibition is being held at The Art Entrance Gallery on Mahatma Gandhi Road till November 16.
Vikas Patnekar, a painter, and national award-winning film director Deepak S.V inaugurated the exhibition on November 10.
Over 30 paintings created using watercolour and acrylic mediums are on display. The collection features landscapes and locations from across India and beyond, including Konkan region, Belagavi, Badami, Hampi, Shimla, Goa, and Nepal.
